notes: 参数表支持变量名和值筛选、工具栏删除选中行、整表及单行复制粘贴和快捷键；新增变量支持数量确认与批量添加。参数引用支持带空格的加减乘除及数字常量，保留原始表达式并显示计算结果、变量来源和错误提示；修复数据标签及大数据窗口中表达式被拆分的问题。

commits.title: 增强参数表操作并支持参数算术表达式
commits.body:
参数表支持变量名和值筛选，删除选中行按钮移至工具栏；支持整表及单行复制粘贴和 Ctrl+C/Ctrl+V，保留输入框原生文本操作。

新增变量改为数量确认卡片，支持批量添加、回车确认、Esc 取消和输入校验。参数引用支持四则运算及数字常量，运算符两侧须有空格；按优先级计算，错误保留原文并提示来源与原因。

保持带空格的参数表达式在数据标签、复制编辑及大数据窗口中的完整性，适配 JSON 高亮和多变量悬停提示。Chrome/Edge 针对性检查及 JS 语法检查通过。

commits.title: Add parameter catalogs and portable release management
commits.body:
Add nested parameter directories, editable name/val/description tables, per-wave table priorities and reusable named presets. Resolve variable references for display while preserving raw text for editing, with source tooltips and SQLite persistence in both browser and service modes.

Consolidate temporary editing sessions and recovery records into .tmp/operations.sqlite without modifying formal Wave libraries before explicit save. Add offline local version comparison, managed directory updates, version history, release manifests and rebuilt Windows/Linux servers for 2026.9.12.3.

Improve linked-image clipboard compatibility and document the new workflows. Verified focused Go persistence, migration and conflict tests plus Chrome/Edge browser workflows and isolated service-mode UI checks. Exclude temporary artifacts and Wave data.

commits.title: Support cross-diagram waveform copy and use t for text editing
commits.body:
Transfer validated rectangular waveform selections and data labels through native clipboard JSON and same-origin window messaging. Preserve destination signal names, titles, groups and existing nodes; append unnamed rows when needed and keep paste undoable as one operation.

Keep text inputs, reading mode and modal dialogs protected, reject unrelated clipboard data, and guard asynchronous reads against document or selection changes. Retain blank rows and continuation labels without copying source names or connection endpoints.

Replace the default Ctrl+T/F2 text-edit bindings with t and migrate legacy saved defaults once while preserving unrelated custom shortcuts and native Vim editing.

Validation: JavaScript syntax and staged diff checks; isolated Chrome tests for cross-window and newly opened window copy/paste, Ctrl+C/Ctrl+V, row/column alignment, metadata preservation, undo/redo, clipboard rejection, t toggling and input/Vim isolation; focused shortcut migration checks. No Wave data or temporary tests included.

commits.title: Improve waveform scrolling and add configurable keyboard shortcuts
commits.body:
Preserve the visible waveform card while lazy previews load or unload, retain measured preview heights, and avoid cancelling smooth scrolling through redundant scroll assignments.

Hide the JSON panel by default while preserving explicit visibility preferences. Add an opt-in non-Vim waveform shortcut checkbox that reuses legend actions and protects text inputs.

Add Settings > Shortcuts for primary and alternate waveform, history, clipboard, deletion and directory bindings, including conflict checks, local persistence and reset. Bind text editing to Ctrl+T with F2 fallback and warn about browser-reserved keys.

Validation: JavaScript syntax and staged diff checks; isolated Chrome checks for waveform action parity, Vim/input isolation, remapping, persistence, cancel/reset and narrow dialog layout; focused lazy-preview scrolling regression checks. No Wave data or temporary test files included.

commits.title: fix: preserve Vim shortcuts and exit text editing with Escape
commits.body:
Route modified keys before Insert/Replace character input so copy, paste, undo and redo are not interpreted as waveform symbols. Preserve snapshot-based overlap paste behavior.

Allow Escape to exit text-edit mode with Vim enabled or disabled. Let inline fields cancel pending text before refreshing mode controls; preserve JSON editor, modal and IME Escape handling. Refresh script cache versions.

Validated with focused Chrome checks for left/right/exact and multirow overlap paste, label binding, undo/redo, and text-editor cancellation.

commits.title: fix: recover interrupted local saves and refine waveform editing
commits.body:
Restore the original server port, temporary SQLite session, and document revisions after an accidental BAT/SH shutdown. Ask for confirmation before launching the project-specific recovery handler, reconnect without reloading, and retry explicit saves while preserving conflict checks.

Add directory expand/collapse-all. Render emptied signal rows without a placeholder cell. Merge adjacent equal binary levels on paste and combine selected data replacements with continuation symbols across toolbar and Vim operations.

Add focused recovery tests and usage documentation. Rebuild Windows/Linux service binaries and update checksums. Wave libraries and temporary files are excluded.

commits.title: feat: support waveform tree drag ordering with clear drop indicators
commits.body:
Allow waveform documents to be dragged before or after other documents, into folders, or to the root. Preserve numbering and library undo/redo, suppress accidental open clicks after drops, and clear drag state when tree rendering detaches source elements.

Remove directory up/down buttons and their unused handlers/styles while retaining signal row controls and directory Tab/Shift+Tab hierarchy shortcuts.

Render an independent insertion line outside clipped title labels, retain inside-folder highlights, refresh the indicator on scrolling/resizing, and clear it after dragging. Update documentation and asset versions.

Validation: JavaScript syntax and diff checks; focused drag handler/history tests and isolated browser verification of before/inside/after/end indicator states. Full native browser drag automation remains unverified.

commits.body:
Add whole-waveform Ctrl+C/Ctrl+V with independent copies, directory placement, automatic numbering, and undo/redo. Preserve JSON and waveform selection clipboard behavior.

Support directory drag-and-drop and Tab/Shift+Tab hierarchy changes. Keep child folders and waveforms together and support history restoration.

Fix title edits targeting synthesized head fields and preserve viewport position when activating waveform editors. Add Word/Markdown link hover guidance and update usage documentation.

Validation: JavaScript syntax and diff checks; focused browser checks for title editing, editor positioning, document copy/paste, history, and clipboard scope.

Enable left-drag canvas panning without waveform rerenders or annotation history changes.

commits.title: feat: extend presenter tools and persist presentation steps
commits.body:
Add pen, eraser, text, arrow and rectangle annotations with undo/redo, focus modes, cursor tools and pointer feedback. Support editable step titles, per-step notes, detachable notes and full/focused image copying.

Persist presentation steps independently in SQLite metadata. Add Save/Ctrl+S, restore on reopen and unsaved-exit confirmation. Protect against conflicting saves and preserve presentation metadata during ordinary waveform writes.

Reuse one presenter window per library and waveform without reloading unsaved content. Keep different waveform windows independent and allow reopening after close.

Update documentation and Windows/Linux server releases. Validate focused presenter/save/window logic, SQLite and server API behavior, JavaScript syntax and release checksums. Actual browser UI verification remains pending.

commits.title: feat: add persistent wave library modes
commits.body:
Add a Wave library model that stores documents, directory titles, and their relationships in a portable JSON bundle. Introduce a same-name Node local service and Windows batch launcher: the service serves the matching HTML, selects the newest Wave library, writes edits back to the active library file, supports switching libraries, and closes after the browser page exits.

Extend direct-file mode with manual Wave library import and downloadable full-library save. Add functional-menu status and controls for the active library, JSON panel visibility, and clickable library selection.

Improve waveform editing: format JSON after waveform-changing toolbar actions; support reversible wave/document/directory actions; add multi-wave library cards, descriptions, grouping, signal controls, data labels, and connection workflows. Empty and per-cell WaveDrom data labels are clickable and editable, including repeated data cells such as 4444 while dotted continuation 4... remains a single label.

Keep temporary backups and user/test Wave data untracked.

Initial commit: VisualWaveDrom single-file HTML editor
commits.body:
Single-file WaveDrom editor with sidebar tools for waveform editing,
connections, tags, and local persistence. Includes inc/ WaveDrom assets
and testChip/ Playwright tests and embed tooling. temp/ and node_modules/ ignored.
